dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "What should I do......? My voice isn't loud enough......"
dialogues.text: "What should I do......? My voice isn't loud enough......"

dialogues.jp: ひんやりと冷たい手が、肩を揺すぶっていた。
dialogues.en: A cold hand is shaking my shoulder.
dialogues.text: A cold hand is shaking my shoulder.

dialogues.jp:
そして、何やら優しげな声。慈母のような、あ
るいは若奥様のような。
dialogues.en:
It's a very gentle voice, like one of an affectionate mother
or a young just-married wife.
dialogues.text:
It's a very gentle voice, like one of an affectionate mother
or a young just-married wife.

dialogues.jp: 「何だよ……悪いもんでも食ったか……？」
dialogues.en:
"What's wrong with you......? Did you eat something
bad......?"
dialogues.text:
"What's wrong with you......? Did you eat something
bad......?"

dialogues.jp: 音夢に背中を向けるよう寝返りを打つ。
dialogues.en: I turn my back on Nemu.
dialogues.text: I turn my back on Nemu.

dialogues.jp:
「それとも、槍でも降らせたいのか？　季節外
　れのスキーを楽しみたいとか……」
dialogues.en:
"Don't do something that you never do, or it'll snow in
spring...... Or is that what you want? Do you feel like
skiing all of the sudden?"
dialogues.text:
"Don't do something that you never do, or it'll snow in
spring...... Or is that what you want? Do you feel like
skiing all of the sudden?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「何でそんなに優しいんだよ？　音夢……」
dialogues.en: "Why are you acting so sweet and kind......? Nemu......"
dialogues.text: "Why are you acting so sweet and kind......? Nemu......"

dialogues.jp:
何となく、妙な雰囲気だな。……俺、変な寝言
でも言ったんだろうか？
dialogues.en:
Something seems weird. ......Did I say something odd in my
sleep?
dialogues.text:
Something seems weird. ......Did I say something odd in my
sleep?

dialogues.jp: 「あっと、とりあえず目覚まし止めようかね」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I have to turn off the alarm."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I have to turn off the alarm."

dialogues.jp:
｛とたん／途端｝に｛せいじゃく／静寂｝。というか、窓の外から朝の物音が
聞こえてくるのが、部屋の静けさを強調する。
dialogues.en:
It's so quiet all of a sudden. I can hear the birds singing
from outside the window, but it only emphasizes the
quietness of the room.
dialogues.text:
It's so quiet all of a sudden. I can hear the birds singing
from outside the window, but it only emphasizes the
quietness of the room.

dialogues.jp: 「あーと、着替えようと思うんだけど」
dialogues.en: "Ummm, I need to put my school uniform on."
dialogues.text: "Ummm, I need to put my school uniform on."

dialogues.jp:
しかし、俺の声が耳に入らないらしく頼子さん
は悲しげに目を伏せたままだ。
dialogues.en:
It seems like she can't hear me. She's still looking down
sadly.
dialogues.text:
It seems like she can't hear me. She's still looking down
sadly.

dialogues.jp:
手の平にじわっと汗がにじむ。俺って奴は、ど
んな寝言を言ったんだ？
dialogues.en: My hands start to sweat. What did I say in my sleep?
dialogues.text: My hands start to sweat. What did I say in my sleep?

dialogues.jp:
ひゃい？　に近い、かん高い音を出してしまっ
たが、頼子さんはそれにも気づかない。
dialogues.en:
I answered in a high nervous voice like a girl, but she
doesn't notice.
dialogues.text:
I answered in a high nervous voice like a girl, but she
doesn't notice.

dialogues.jp:
私を、何でしょうか？　余程言いづらいのか、
いつもよりタメが長い。ほとんど、放送事故
ぎりぎりである。
dialogues.en:
I did what? She's really hesitating to say it and dragging
it out so long.
dialogues.text:
I did what? She's really hesitating to say it and dragging
it out so long.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「私を……妹さんと間違えました……」

あのゆりかごのような体感は、頼子さんがやっ
てくれたのか。夢だと思った。
dialogues.en:
I finally understand that the feeling I felt in my dream of
being in a rocking cradle was caused by her.
dialogues.text:
I finally understand that the feeling I felt in my dream of
being in a rocking cradle was caused by her.

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんは何やら恨めしげな顔だ。白い三角の
布を被れば、ちょっとした幽霊といったところ。
dialogues.en:
Yoriko is giving me a rueful look. If she was wearing white
clothes, she could look like a ghost.
dialogues.text:
Yoriko is giving me a rueful look. If she was wearing white
clothes, she could look like a ghost.

dialogues.jp:
「いや、悪かった。ちくっと寝ぼけていてね。
　頼子さんに起こされたのは初めてだったし」
dialogues.en:
"I'm sorry. I was half asleep, and today is the first time
you woke me up, you know."
dialogues.text:
"I'm sorry. I was half asleep, and today is the first time
you woke me up, you know."

dialogues.jp: しゅぱっと、顔の前で手刀を切った。
dialogues.en:
I put my hands clasped in front of my face as a gesture of
an apology.
dialogues.text:
I put my hands clasped in front of my face as a gesture of
an apology.

dialogues.jp:
ようやく表情を緩めてくれる。窓からの物音が、
今度は朝の｛さわ／爽｝やかさの演出へと変化した。
dialogues.en:
The tension on her face finally disperses. I think the birds
also start singing in a joyful tone.
dialogues.text:
The tension on her face finally disperses. I think the birds
also start singing in a joyful tone.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
（しかし、名前を間違えただけで、あれだけ悲
　しそうにするとは……）
dialogues.en:
(She looked very sad just because I called her by the wrong
name......)
dialogues.text:
(She looked very sad just because I called her by the wrong
name......)

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: (Humm... I can never underestimate women's hearts......)
dialogues.text: (Humm... I can never underestimate women's hearts......)

dialogues.jp:
本日二度目となる朝の挨拶を口にしつつ、部屋
に入る。
dialogues.en:
Walking into the living room, I say good morning for the
second time today.
dialogues.text:
Walking into the living room, I say good morning for the
second time today.

dialogues.jp:
テーブルの上には既に朝食が用意されていて、
思わず驚きの声をもらしてしまう。
dialogues.en: There's breakfast on the table, and I gasp in surprise.
dialogues.text: There's breakfast on the table, and I gasp in surprise.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「いやいや、美味そうな朝食だと思ってね」
dialogues.en: "No, no. I was just thinking the breakfast looks fabulous."
dialogues.text: "No, no. I was just thinking the breakfast looks fabulous."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「いつも通りだと……思うんですが……」
dialogues.en: "They are the same breakfast you always make......"
dialogues.text: "They are the same breakfast you always make......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "But I can tell you put your heart into it."
dialogues.text: "But I can tell you put your heart into it."

dialogues.jp:
冗談のつもりだったのに、赤面されるとこっち
まで恥ずかしくなる。
dialogues.en:
It was a joke, but her face turns red and it makes me feel
embarrassed.
dialogues.text:
It was a joke, but her face turns red and it makes me feel
embarrassed.

dialogues.jp:
むしゃむしゃとトーストにかぶりつきながら、
声をかける。
dialogues.en: I take a big bite of my toast and ask her.
dialogues.text: I take a big bite of my toast and ask her.

dialogues.jp:
「何か欲しい物があったら、俺に──って、頼
　子さん？」
dialogues.en:
"If you need or want anything, let me know...... Yoriko-san?
Hello?"
dialogues.text:
"If you need or want anything, let me know...... Yoriko-san?
Hello?"

dialogues.jp: 反応のなさに、顔をあげる。
こっくり、こっくり。舟を｛こ／漕｝いでいた。

その人形のような可愛らしさに、腹筋が過度の
緊張を強いられる。
dialogues.en:
She looks like a doll, and she's so cute. It makes my gut
tense up.
dialogues.text:
She looks like a doll, and she's so cute. It makes my gut
tense up.

dialogues.jp:
片手にトーストを持ったまま寝入っていて、ま
るきり子どもみたいだった。さすがに、口の中
は空っぽみたいだが。
dialogues.en:
She's sleeping with a piece of toast in her hand, just like
a little kid. But she's not like a real kid eating and
sleeping at the same time -- she doesn't have any food in
her mouth.
dialogues.text:
She's sleeping with a piece of toast in her hand, just like
a little kid. But she's not like a real kid eating and
sleeping at the same time -- she doesn't have any food in
her mouth.

dialogues.jp:
目覚ましで早起きしたから、こんな風に居眠り
してしまったんだろうか？
dialogues.en:
Maybe because she woke up so early with her new alarm clock,
she's very sleepy.
dialogues.text:
Maybe because she woke up so early with her new alarm clock,
she's very sleepy.

dialogues.jp:
「ともかく、とりあえず、頭突きをかましても
　大丈夫なようにしておこう」
dialogues.en:
"At least I should prevent the worst situation in case she
hits her head on the table."
dialogues.text:
"At least I should prevent the worst situation in case she
hits her head on the table."

dialogues.jp:
予想着弾ポイントから、コーヒーカップと皿を
どける。
dialogues.en: I remove her coffee cup and plate from the target area.
dialogues.text: I remove her coffee cup and plate from the target area.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、あどけないっていう言葉が、ここまで
似合う寝顔も珍しいな……。
dialogues.en:
I've never seen a sleeping face that is as innocent and
angelic as hers......
dialogues.text:
I've never seen a sleeping face that is as innocent and
angelic as hers......

dialogues.jp:
今朝は頼子さんが起こしてくれたのだが、どう
やら俺が寝ぼけて音夢と間違えてしまったらし
く、哀しい顔をされてしまった。

その後、早起きしたせいか、トーストを片手に
眠ってしまった頼子さんの顔は本当にあどけな
かった。
